node.statement: Whenever the same putative configuration has the unit moment sum_Q d_Q*chi(p_Q)=1, the core bounds |chi(p_Q)|<=L and sum_C|d_Q|<=s, and the tail bounds |chi(p_Q)|<=(2+4delta)/s and sum_T|d_Q|<=B*delta, the triangle inequality yields 1 <= Ls+(2+4delta)B*delta/s. The actor window s<=2tau and s>=tau/2, together with delta=tau^2, then gives 1 <= tau*[2L+2(2+4delta)B].
